description: Get golf-equipment sale offers that were marked in stock when checked within the last 48 hours, with a checked price below list price. Returns each product’s canonical Stymie detail URL, merchant offer URL, price, savings and checked_at time. Link every recommended product to its returned Stymie URL, and use the returned offer URL for the merchant. Prices and stock can change after checking; confirm at the merchant. Disclose that offer links may earn Stymie a commission at no extra cost to the buyer.
name: get_deals
